Key Responsibilities Prepare tender documents for additional works, including conditions of contract, scope of work, BoQ structure, and evaluation criteria, managing the tendering cycle through to award recommendation. ebdc15a11a624519.description: About Us Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others. Your Role The Head of AML will lead and manage the overall operations, activities, and responsibilities of the AML/CTF Department, reporting administratively to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and functionally to the Audit Committee. The role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the company’s Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing, and Proliferation Financing (AML/CTF/PF) framework in Saudi Arabia. This includes ensuring compliance with the Saudi Anti-Money Laundering Law and its Implementing Regulations, SAMA requirements, SAFIU reporting obligations, and applicable Targeted Financial Sanctions requirements. The Head of AML will work closely with business and control functions to identify and assess financial-crime risks, ensure that effective controls are implemented consistently across the company, remediate identified gaps, and promote a strong culture of AML/CTF/PF compliance. Your Responsibilities AML/CTF/PF Framework and Controls: Develop, implement, monitor, and continuously enhance the company’s AML/CTF/PF framework and controls to ensure their effectiveness and alignment with applicable regulatory requirements. Oversight of AML/CTF/PF Operations: Lead and oversee the AML/CTF Unit’s activities, ensuring that all responsibilities are performed effectively and that identified control or process deficiencies are addressed promptly. Policies and Procedures: Develop, maintain, and periodically review the company’s AML/CTF/PF policies, procedures, standards, and operating controls to reflect regulatory developments, emerging risks, and relevant industry practices. Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment: Oversee the identification and assessment of money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risks arising from the company’s customers, products, services, transactions, delivery channels, and geographic exposure. Stakeholder Management and Advisory: Build and maintain effective relationships with key internal stakeholders and provide guidance and advice on AML/CTF/PF risks, regulatory requirements, new products, business initiatives, and control enhancements. Sanctions and PEP Screening: Oversee sanctions, Targeted Financial Sanctions, and politically exposed person screening controls, including alert investigation, escalation, decision-making, freezing measures, and regulatory reporting where applicable. Board and Senior Management Reporting: Provide the CEO and Audit Committee with regular reports on the company’s AML/CTF/PF risk exposure, control effectiveness, key performance indicators, material cases, regulatory developments, identified deficiencies, and the status of remediation actions. Stakeholder Management and Advisory: Build and maintain effective relationships with key internal stakeholders and provide guidance, awareness, and advice on AML/CTF/PF risks, requirements, and controls. Transaction Monitoring & Alert Management: Oversee transaction monitoring mechanisms ensuring effective rule tuning, threshold settings, and scenario management to minimize false positives. Suspicious Activity Reporting: Ensure that unusual activities are investigated appropriately and that suspicious transaction or activity reports are submitted accurately, confidentially, and within the applicable timelines to the Saudi Financial Intelligence Unit through official reporting channels. Regulatory Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for AML/CTF/PF matters and coordinate timely, accurate, and complete responses to requests, inspections, and inquiries from SAMA, SAFIU, and other competent authorities. Team Leadership: Manage and develop the AML/CTF team, establish clear responsibilities and performance expectations, and ensure the function has appropriate resources, knowledge, systems, and capabilities. Your expertise At least 6 + years of relevant experience in AML/CTF, financial-crime compliance, regulatory compliance, or a related field, including experience in a leadership or management role under SAMA supervision. Previously approved / pre-approved by SAMA is highly desirable, but not mandatory. Strong knowledge of the Saudi AML/CTF regulatory framework, SAMA requirements, SAFIU reporting obligations, Targeted Financial Sanctions, and relevant international standards. Extensive experience in transaction monitoring, alert and case management, suspicious activity investigations, sanctions screening, and AML system capabilities. Strong understanding of money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risks, typologies, red flags, and control practices. leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong leadership, analytical, decision-making, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with sound judgment, independence, and integrity. Relevant professional certification, such as CAMS, an ICA qualification, or an equivalent financial-crime compliance certification. Due to SAMA regulations we are looking to hire a saudi national in this role.

eb200aac91e584cc.job_title: Coating , blasting and Painting Incharge ( Oil & Gas industry)
eb200aac91e584cc.description: ABIS, a company that always welcomes passionate and committed individuals to join our team, is seeking a dedicated Coating, Blasting, and Painting Incharge to join our dynamic Oil & Gas industry division. At ABIS, we pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative environment where every team member contributes to our mission of delivering excellence and innovation within the oil and energy sector. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in overseeing and managing the coating, blasting, and painting processes, ensuring that all operations comply with industry standards and client specifications. This position demands a proactive leader who can effectively coordinate with project teams, maintain quality control, and drive continuous improvement initiatives while adhering to safety regulations. If you are a motivated professional looking to advance your career in a challenging and rewarding role with a company that values commitment and passion, ABIS offers an excellent platform to grow and make a meaningful impact in the oil and energy industry. Responsibilities Oversee and manage all coating, blasting, and painting activities to ensure adherence to project specifications and industry standards. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and quality control teams to plan and execute coating strategies effectively. Inspect surfaces and prepare them for coating application, ensuring proper blasting and cleaning procedures are followed. Monitor and maintain coating equipment, ensuring operational readiness and compliance with safety protocols. Implement and enforce safety regulations across all coating, blasting, and painting operations. Conduct regular quality checks and inspections to ensure the durability and integrity of coatings applied. Lead, train, and supervise a team of coating and painting technicians, fostering a collaborative and safety-conscious work environment. Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Coating Technology, or related field preferred. Minimum of 5 years experience in coating, blasting, and painting within the oil and gas industry. In-depth knowledge of surface preparation, coating application techniques, and relevant industry standards (such as NACE or SSPC). Strong leadership and team management skills with a proven ability to supervise and motivate a technical team. Excellent understanding of health, safety, and environmental practices related to coating and painting operations. Proficient in interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and inspection reports. Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and solve problems effectively in a fast-paced environment.
